name: select
text: Select a villager: right click on one of your villagers with the command stick.

name: wood
text: Gather 50 wood: select a villager and right click on a tree.

name: house
text: Build a house: right click on a selected villager, choose the house and place it.

name: villager
text: Train a villager: right click on your town center and choose the villager.

name: camps
text: Build a lumber camp near the trees and a mill near the berries.

name: food
text: Gather 100 food: send a villager to the berries.

name: feudal
text: Advance to the Feudal Age: right click on your town center and choose the Feudal Age.

name: barracks
text: Build a barracks: right click on a selected villager, choose the barracks and place it.

name: militia
text: Train 3 Militia: right click on your barracks and choose the militia.

name: raid
text: The enemy attacks your villagers! Click the red alert line in the chat to go there, then select your Militia and right click on the enemies.

name: camp
text: Destroy the enemy camp in the middle of the map: select your Militia and right click on a building.
